motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council INSTRUCT the Los Angeles Department of Transportation (LADOT) to increase the number of buses and bus drivers deployed for the DASH Boyle Heights/East LA route to run every 10-15 minutes Monday through Saturday. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council INSTRUCT LADOT to implement the updated route immediately until the emergency declaration has been lifted. PRESENTED BY < YSABELJURADQ 4 Councilmember, 14th District SECONDED BY glololeollk JUN 478%,
title: Boyle Heights / East Los Angeles / Cold Storage Warehouse / Fire / Department of Transportation / Increase Bus Service
